full.free_text:
Staff Nurse

Experience
Staff Nurse | Ruby Hall Clinic, Pune | Jul 2018 - Present
- Care for 8-10 patients per shift in the medical-surgical ward: assess condition, record vital signs and update nursing notes.
- Administer oral, IV and injectable medications as prescribed and watch for reactions.
- Prepare patients for procedures, change dressings, manage IV lines and catheters.
- Inform the doctor about changes in a patient's condition and follow up on orders.
- Teach patients and families about medicines, wound care and diet before discharge.

Education
B.Sc Nursing, 2018. BLS certified.

partial.free_text: Final-year GNM student. During clinical postings I helped staff nurses take temperature and BP, made beds and fed patients. Looking for my first nursing job.

other.free_text: Sales executive for a pharma distributor, 4 years. I visit chemists and clinics, take orders for medicines, collect payments and meet monthly targets.

jobs.title: Staff Nurse
jobs.description: A Medical degree and the successful completion of a residency and fellowship in urology. A state license and certification to practice urology. The ability to keep updated on the latest medical technologies. The flexibility to work irregular hours and remain on emergency call. Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Good teamworking, leadership, and organizational skills.

json.description: Assess patient health problems and needs, develop and implement nursing care plans, and maintain medical records. Administer nursing care to ill, injured, convalescent, or disabled patients. May advise patients on health maintenance and disease prevention or provide case management. Licensing or registration required.
